g.text: 130.0 m HORIZONTAL PLANE (ZERO STAIRS / ZERO ELEVATORS)
45.0 m ACADEMY (CLEAR WEST OF BLDG F)
LONGITUDINAL SECTION C-C' (EAST-WEST) — UNIVERSAL Y=0.0m SLAB, SAWTOOTH DAYLIGHTING & SCULPTED SHELL AUDITORIUM
No 2nd floor, no wet-lab roof alteration; wider East/West wall ties.
1. Zero stairs or freight elevators across the entire 4,140 m² facility.
2. Every classroom sits on slab-on-grade (heavy AFM/tensile rigs anywhere).
3. North-facing sawtooth roof monitors give 500 lux glare-free daylight.
4. Salk limestone reflecting court aligns cleanly West of Neighbor Bldg F.
5. Gallery around Zone 14 routes Break Lounge cleanly into East Bakehouse.
6. Largest roof envelope (~4,140 m²) and longest ~125m end-to-end runs.
